scope: Independent source review only; no source adapter, production activation or runtime acceptance

criteria.assertion: Exercise canonical operation resolver, actual current authority and actual dispatcher for list and search first and subsequent pages. No replacement validator, duplicated filter digest algorithm or hand-built alternate dispatcher.

Bind retained continuation to full task binding, operation/version, policy, canonical normalized selection/filter, requested offset and asOf anchor, and full trusted subject including authorizationDecisionId. Reject changed decision at prepare/before/effect/release/final and between pages; preserve the separate accepted memory decision-rotation convention.

Prior pages come only from configured trusted retained-context ports using raw inert JSON receipts. Reject absent/corrupt/overbound/stale/future/wrong-key/wrong-digest/expired context, injected model context and accessor/proxy values without executing getters. Snapshot/freeze data supplied across awaited ports.

Pass the original retained page into the canonical mail validator. Preserve nextOffset/asOf, filter/limit/folder/query restrictions, full subject/binding/window continuity, unknown enumeration, null snapshot/version, incomplete preview, required decisive reads and no evidence/absence promotion.

Use existing absolute dispatch lifetime around load and retain; publish fresh authority or retained expiry as soon as known. Park load/retain/settle independently, shorten current authority deadlines, cancel and release late promises; result release and later effects must remain suppressed. No physical cancellation claim.

Authorization remains current before reservation/effect/result retention and final release. Refusal before reservation has no budget/effect calls; uncertainty after attempted reservation stays accounted; late settlement/refusal is not a retry/refund or renewed authority.

Retention only for valid continuable output; bind exact canonical output/request and receipt hashes with bounded expiry. Terminal or unknown-total pages do not fabricate continuation; retaining a page does not make it approved evidence or successful publication.

Only allocated mail context module and narrow operation-context/tool-dispatch edits, plus new author tests/docs. All schemas/validators/public contracts/locks/other existing source and original tests stay preserved; original memory behavior and disabled canonical gateway remain intact.

Preserve meaningful raw failures, exact candidate commits and independent evidence. Report ACCEPT_SOURCE/HOLD with passed/failed/unrun, no private data or source connection, no proxy/worker/scripts/native/SQL/provider/cloud execution, no nested agents or dormant jobs.
